items.name: Studio Tour and Gallery Experience
items.description: Saturday: Visitors are invited to tour the studio floor and see how Robert McMillan makes and applies his multilayered glazes. The gallery experience also includes a photo screen for family and friends fall photos, with music, laughter, stories, and socializing.
items.extractionReason: The post explicitly invites visitors to take a studio tour and enjoy a gallery experience, including a photo opportunity, during the stated Saturday access hours.
